title.en: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A SECOND REVISION OF THE ASSESSMENTS OR VALUATIONS UPON REAL ESTATE IN THE PROVINCE OF LA LAGUNA.
title.orig: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A SECOND REVISION OF THE ASSESSMENTS OR VALUATIONS UPON REAL ESTATE IN THE PROVINCE OF LA LAGUNA.
title.vi: Luật quy định việc sửa đổi lần thứ hai các mức định giá bất động sản tại tỉnh La Laguna

title.id: Undang-Undang menetapkan revisi kedua atas penilaian atau taksiran properti di Provinsi La Laguna

text.en:
The provincial board of La Laguna is hereby constituted a special board, with authority to correct
all erroneous assessments or valuations upon parcels of land in said province which arise from clerical errors,
mistakes or double assessments. The assessment lists of the said lands, when so made or corrected, shall be
as lawful and valid for all purposes as though the corrections and assessments herein provided for had been
made in accordance with lav at the proper time.

The listings and revision of the valuations and assessments herein provided for shall be made and
completed on or before the first day of September, nineteen hundred and four. The board shall give notice to
the municipal authorities of the various municipalities of the province, and all complaints shall be heard
under such reasonable rules and regulations as the said board may provide. No appeal shall be allowed from
the action of the said board, and the action of the majority thereof shall he deemed to be the action of the
board, and binding.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, July 26, 1904.
